project: EWP roof access for guttering and flashing replacement on 2-storey commercial building with overhead power lines
scope_of_works: Boom lift EWP used to access roof perimeter for removal of damaged guttering and flashing, and installation of new Colorbond guttering and flashing on a 2-storey commercial building. Overhead power lines run along one elevation. Workers transfer from EWP basket onto the roof via the perimeter to access install zones, returning to the basket for descent. Applicable HRCW: risk of a person falling more than 2 metres; movement of powered mobile plant (boom lift EWP); work in proximity to energised electrical installations (overhead power lines).
quick_scan_focus: EWP positioning and ground bearing controls
EWP-to-roof transfer point controls (gap, anchor, spotter)
